hooks.name: setup-session
hooks.description: When a session starts, check that Node matches .nvmrc and run npm ci, so npm run check works in a fresh cloud clone. Fails loudly with the Node version when it does not match. Works from the repository root or the workspace root that contains the clone (Kiro Web).

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"; [ -f scripts/setup-session.sh ] || for d in */; do [ -f "$d/scripts/setup-session.sh" ] && cd "$d" && break; done; bash scripts/setup-session.sh
